extracted.intended_audience: Ohio businesses, regulated parties, state agency rulewriters, and stakeholders interested in Ohio regulatory reform
extracted.subtask_description: Describes Ohio's Common Sense Initiative (CSI), the state program that reviews state agency rules for business impact, identifies regulatory obstacles, and leads initiatives to amend or rescind burdensome regulations. Provides related resources such as a Business Impact Analysis template and eNotification signup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review business-impacting rules
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI has reviewed more than 17,000 state agency rules during the DeWine Administration — the program’s core activity is systematic review of rules to assess their impacts on businesses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify potential obstacles to businesses
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify regulations that are potential obstacles to Ohio businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI identified over 55 percent of the reviewed regulations as potential obstacles to Ohio businesses; identification is used as the basis for recommending changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amend or rescind burdensome regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: Regulations identified as obstacles should be amended or rescinded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All regulations identified by CSI as potential obstacles were either amended or rescinded — this is the expected corrective action once an obstacle is found.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote job and economic growth through regulatory reform
rubrics_metrics.description: CSI’s purpose is to propel job and economic growth in Ohio by improving the regulatory climate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluations and initiatives are oriented toward reducing regulatory barriers that impede business growth and job creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Help businesses navigate regulatory obstacles
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide assistance and resources to help businesses navigate regulatory obstacles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI 'helps businesses navigate regulatory obstacles' and directs stakeholders to resources such as eNotifications, the Register of Ohio, related laws & forms, and the Business Impact Analysis templates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare and use a Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a Business Impact Analysis to document business impacts of rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page links to a 'Business Impact Analysis Template' and a 'Business Impact Analysis Template for Rescinded Rules', indicating that formal BIAs are a procedural/resource standard used in CSI reviews and rulemaking actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notify stakeholders via eNotifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Use eNotifications to keep stakeholders informed about agency rule reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI directs interested parties to sign up for agency rule review eNotifications to 'stay informed about news impacting business', suggesting stakeholder notification is an expected part of the process.
